title: A method and platform for urban and rural joint smart medical treatment based on federated learning, edge computing, and cloud-edge collaboration
assignee: Zhongtongfu Network Information Technology Co ltd

pse.problem: Uneven distribution of medical resources in cities and rural areas, difficulty and high cost of medical treatment for rural patients, deficiencies in data processing and privacy protection in existing smart medical systems.
pse.solution_function: Integration of urban and rural medical resources, secure sharing and intelligent analysis of medical data, improvement of accuracy and efficiency of diagnosis and treatment through federated learning, edge computing, and cloud-edge collaboration. Preliminary analysis of patient cases, screening out the cases that need further diagnosis, giving a preliminary treatment plan by edge computing device AI algorithm.
pse.solution_structure: End-side devices in each township medical institution, edge devices near end-side devices, smart medical treatment platform connecting terminal devices and edge devices, resource base of township and urban doctors, AI algorithm model for federated learning, kubeEdge, cloud Kubernetes.
pse.solution_implementation: Installation of end-side devices and edge devices, deployment of smart medical treatment platform, packaging of AI algorithm model, federated learning, and collection program into an image, sending the image to edge device through cloud Kubernetes and kubeEdge for container mode run, uploading of patient examination data and medical treatment data by end-side devices and doctors, preliminary analysis and treatment plan generation by edge computing device AI algorithm.
pse.effect: Improved accuracy and efficiency of diagnosis and treatment, cross-regional and cross-institutional medical data sharing, joint diagnosis and treatment by urban and rural doctors
